html:
Mecklenburg-Strelitz was a small duchy in northern Germany, created in 1701 when the house of Mecklenburg split its lands, with Mecklenburg-Schwerin as the larger part. It is on the map for 1783 and 1800, though the map draws it in the wrong place, over Hanover.

Its capital became Neustrelitz, a planned town built in the 1730s. The duchy was poor and rural, but its princesses married well. Charlotte married George III of Britain in 1761 and became queen. Her niece Louise became queen of Prussia and was loved for standing up to Napoleon. In 1815 the duchy became a grand duchy. It lasted until 1918, and in 1934 it was merged with Schwerin.
